title: Multi-DNN Inference of Sparse Models on Edge SoCs
summary: Modern edge applications increasingly require multi-DNN inference systems to execute tasks on heterogeneous processors, gaining performance from both concurrent execution and from matching each model to the most suited accelerator. However, existing systems support only a single model (or a few sparse variants) per task, which impedes the efficiency of this matching and results in high Service Level Objective violation rates. We introduce model stitching for multi-DNN inference systems, which creates model variants by recombining subgraphs from sparse models without re-training. We present a demonstrator system, SparseLoom, that shows model stitching can be deployed to SoCs. We show experimentally that SparseLoom reduces SLO violation rates by up to 74%, improves throughput by up to 2.31x, and lowers memory overhead by an average of 28% compared to state-of-the-art multi-DNN inference systems.

AI.title_translation: 边缘SoC上稀疏模型的多DNN推理
AI.tldr: 提出“模型拼接（model stitching）”在无需重新训练的情况下通过重组稀疏模型子图生成更多模型变体，并在系统SparseLoom中落地到边缘SoC；实验显示SLO违约率最高降低74%，吞吐最高提升2.31倍，平均内存开销降低28%。
AI.motivation: 边缘应用需要在异构处理器上进行多DNN并发推理，并将不同模型匹配到最合适的加速器以提升性能；但现有系统每个任务仅支持单一模型（或少量稀疏变体），限制匹配效率并导致较高的SLO违约率。
AI.method: 提出模型拼接：从稀疏模型中抽取并重组子图，组合生成新的模型变体且无需重新训练；实现并展示系统SparseLoom，证明该方法可部署在边缘SoC的多DNN推理系统中以支持更丰富的模型-加速器匹配与并发执行。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比最新的多DNN推理系统，SparseLoom可将SLO违约率最多降低74%，吞吐量最多提升2.31倍，并将内存开销平均降低28%。
AI.conclusion: 通过无需训练的子图重组生成模型变体（模型拼接）能够显著提升边缘SoC上的多DNN推理系统在SLO达成、吞吐与内存效率方面的表现，并具备可部署性。
AI.translation: 现代边缘应用日益需要多DNN推理系统在异构处理器上执行任务，通过并发执行以及将每个模型匹配到最适合的加速器来获得性能。然而，现有系统每个任务仅支持单一模型（或少数稀疏变体），这阻碍了这种匹配的效率并导致较高的服务级别目标（SLO）违约率。我们为多DNN推理系统引入模型拼接（model stitching），它通过在无需重新训练的情况下重组稀疏模型的子图来创建模型变体。我们提出演示系统SparseLoom，展示模型拼接可以部署到SoC上。实验表明，与最先进的多DNN推理系统相比，SparseLoom可将SLO违约率最多降低74%，吞吐量最多提升2.31倍，并将内存开销平均降低28%。
AI.summary: 本文针对边缘SoC上多DNN推理在异构加速器匹配受限、SLO违约率高的问题，提出模型拼接技术：从稀疏模型中重组子图以生成大量无需再训练的模型变体，并在SparseLoom系统中实现落地。实验显示该方案显著降低SLO违约率、提升吞吐并减少内存开销，优于现有多DNN推理系统。
AI.keywords: 多DNN推理; 边缘计算; SoC; 异构处理器; 稀疏模型; 模型拼接; 子图重组; SLO; 吞吐量; 内存开销; SparseLoom
AI.comments: 创新点在于通过“子图重组”扩展可用模型变体集合，从而更细粒度地进行模型-加速器匹配且无需重新训练，并在SoC上给出系统级演示与量化收益；具体拼接约束、适用模型类型与实验设置细节在摘要中未提及。

title: MM-tau-p$^2$: Persona-Adaptive Prompting for Robust Multi-Modal Agent Evaluation in Dual-Control Settings
comments: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal both voice and text LLM agents in dualcontrol settings. We introduce persona adaptive prompting and 12 new metrics to assess robustness safety efficiency and recovery in customer support scenarios
summary: Current evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for LLM powered agents focus on text chat driven agents, these frameworks do not expose the persona of user to the agent, thus operating in a user agnostic environment. Importantly, in customer experience management domain, the agent's behaviour evolves as the agent learns about user personality. With proliferation of real time TTS and multi-modal language models, LLM based agents are gradually going to become multi-modal. Towards this, we propose the MM-tau-p$^2$ benchmark with metrics for evaluating the robustness of multi-modal agents in dual control setting with and without persona adaption of user, while also taking user inputs in the planning process to resolve a user query. In particular, our work shows that even with state of-the-art frontier LLMs like GPT-5, GPT 4.1, there are additional considerations measured using metrics viz. multi-modal robustness, turn overhead while introducing multi-modality into LLM based agents. Overall, MM-tau-p$^2$ builds on our prior work FOCAL and provides a holistic way of evaluating multi-modal agents in an automated way by introducing 12 novel metrics. We also provide estimates of these metrics on the telecom and retail domains by using the LLM-as-judge approach using carefully crafted prompts with well defined rubrics for evaluating each conversation.
comment: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal both voice and text LLM agents in dualcontrol settings. We introduce persona adaptive prompting and 12 new metrics to assess robustness safety efficiency and recovery in customer support scenarios

AI.title_translation: MM-tau-p^2：用于双控制设定下稳健多模态智能体评测的角色（Persona）自适应提示方法
AI.tldr: 提出MM-tau-p^2基准与12个新指标，用于在“双控制”场景下评测多模态LLM智能体在有/无用户角色自适应时的稳健性，并用LLM-as-judge在电信与零售域给出指标估计。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评测多聚焦文本聊天且对用户角色不可见，导致“用户无关”评测；但在客户体验管理中智能体会随对用户人格/偏好的了解而改变行为，同时多模态能力（TTS、多模态模型）正在普及，需要面向多模态与角色自适应的稳健评测框架。
AI.method: 提出MM-tau-p^2基准：在双控制设置下（包含用户输入参与规划以解决查询）评测多模态智能体，并比较有/无用户角色自适应两种条件；构建12个新指标（包括多模态稳健性、引入多模态后的轮次开销等）；在电信与零售领域采用LLM-as-judge方式，通过精心设计的提示与明确rubric对对话进行自动化评审并估计指标。
AI.result: 实验/评估表明：即使使用GPT-5、GPT-4.1等前沿模型，多模态引入后仍存在需额外关注的问题，可由提出的指标（如多模态稳健性、轮次开销）捕捉；并给出了电信与零售领域的指标估计结果（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: MM-tau-p^2在FOCAL基础上提供一种更整体、可自动化的多模态智能体评测方式，能够在双控制与角色自适应维度上更全面衡量智能体鲁棒性与对话代价。
AI.translation: 当前针对LLM驱动智能体的评测框架与基准主要聚焦于文本聊天式智能体；这些框架不会向智能体暴露用户的角色设定，因此处于与用户无关的环境中。重要的是，在客户体验管理领域，智能体的行为会随着其逐步了解用户人格而演化。随着实时TTS与多模态语言模型的普及，基于LLM的智能体将逐渐变为多模态。为此，我们提出MM-tau-p^2基准，并给出用于评估双控制设置下多模态智能体鲁棒性的指标，覆盖“有/无用户角色自适应”，同时在规划过程中纳入用户输入以解决用户查询。我们的工作表明，即便采用GPT-5、GPT-4.1等最先进的前沿LLM，在将多模态引入LLM智能体时仍存在可由指标度量的额外考量，例如多模态鲁棒性与轮次开销。总体而言，MM-tau-p^2在我们先前的FOCAL工作基础上，通过引入12个新指标，以自动化方式提供对多模态智能体的整体评测方法。我们还使用LLM-as-judge方法，在电信与零售领域通过带有明确评分细则的精心设计提示，对每段对话进行评估并给出这些指标的估计。
AI.summary: 论文针对现有智能体评测忽略用户persona且主要局限文本模态的问题，提出面向多模态与用户persona自适应的MM-tau-p^2评测基准。在“双控制”设定下，基准比较智能体在有/无persona自适应时的表现，并在规划中显式利用用户输入解决查询。作者在FOCAL基础上新增12个指标，强调多模态引入带来的稳健性与轮次开销等维度；并用LLM-as-judge结合严格rubric，在电信与零售场景对这些指标进行自动化估计，指出即便前沿模型也存在多模态评测下的额外挑战。
AI.keywords: 多模态智能体评测, Persona自适应, 双控制(dual-control), 基准测试(benchmark), 鲁棒性指标, 轮次开销, LLM-as-judge, 自动化评测, 客户体验管理, TTS
AI.comments: 创新点：将persona可见性/自适应与多模态鲁棒性纳入统一基准，并提出12个新指标；实用性：提供自动化评测流程与跨域（电信、零售）估计。局限：摘要未说明“双控制”形式化定义、12个指标的具体列表与计算方式、数据规模与具体定量结果。

title: Well Log-Guided Synthesis of Subsurface Images from Sparse Petrography Data Using cGANs
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures. Extended abstract presented at the Fifth EAGE Digitalization Conference & Exhibition, 24-26 March 2025, United Kingdom
summary: Pore-scale imaging of subsurface formations is costly and limited to discrete depths, creating significant gaps in reservoir characterization. To address this, we present a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) framework for synthesizing realistic thin section images of carbonate rock formations, conditioned on porosity values derived from well logs. The model is trained on 5,000 sub-images extracted from 15 petrography samples over a depth interval of 1992-2000m, the model generates geologically consistent images across a wide porosity range (0.004-0.745), achieving 81% accuracy within a 10\% margin of target porosity values. The successful integration of well log data with the trained generator enables continuous pore-scale visualization along the wellbore, bridging gaps between discrete core sampling points and providing valuable insights for reservoir characterization and energy transition applications such as carbon capture and underground hydrogen storage.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Extended abstract presented at the Fifth EAGE Digitalization Conference & Exhibition, 24-26 March 2025, United Kingdom

AI.title_translation: 利用cGAN在井测测井引导下从稀疏岩相学数据合成地下图像
AI.tldr: 提出一种以测井孔隙度为条件的cGAN，用少量薄片样本训练后可在井筒深度方向连续生成与目标孔隙度一致的碳酸盐岩薄片图像，从而弥补离散取芯成像的空白。
AI.motivation: 地下地层孔隙尺度成像成本高且仅在离散深度获取，导致储层表征存在显著空缺；需要一种方法在有限岩相薄片数据条件下实现连续的孔隙尺度可视化。
AI.method: 构建条件生成对抗网络（cGAN），以测井得到的孔隙度数值作为条件输入来生成碳酸盐岩薄片（thin section）图像；使用从15个岩相薄片样本在1992–2000 m深度区间提取的5,000个子图进行训练，并在较宽孔隙度范围内生成图像。
AI.result: 模型可在孔隙度范围0.004–0.745内生成地质一致的图像；在目标孔隙度±10%误差带内达到81%的准确率；结合测井条件后可沿井筒实现连续孔隙尺度可视化。
AI.conclusion: 将测井孔隙度与生成模型成功融合，可在离散取芯点之间合成连续、合理的孔隙尺度图像，提升储层表征能力，并对碳捕集与地下储氢等能源转型应用具有价值。
AI.translation: 孔隙尺度的地下地层成像成本高且只能在离散深度获取，从而在储层表征中造成显著空缺。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）框架，在测井获得的孔隙度数值条件约束下合成逼真的碳酸盐岩薄片图像。该模型基于1992–2000 m深度区间内15个岩相学样品提取的5,000个子图进行训练，可在0.004–0.745的宽孔隙度范围内生成地质一致的图像，并在目标孔隙度±10%的误差范围内达到81%的准确率。将测井数据与训练好的生成器集成后，可沿井筒实现连续的孔隙尺度可视化，弥合离散取芯采样点之间的空白，为储层表征以及碳捕集与地下储氢等能源转型应用提供有价值的洞见。
AI.summary: 本文针对薄片/孔隙尺度图像获取昂贵且深度离散的问题，提出以测井孔隙度为条件的cGAN生成框架。模型用15个样品的5,000个子图训练后，能够在较宽孔隙度范围内生成与地质特征一致的碳酸盐岩薄片图像，并在孔隙度目标匹配（±10%）上取得81%准确率。该方法实现沿井筒的连续孔隙尺度可视化，用于弥补取芯间隔导致的信息缺口，服务于储层表征及CCS/地下储氢等场景。
AI.keywords: 条件生成对抗网络,cGAN,测井数据,孔隙度,薄片图像,碳酸盐岩,孔隙尺度成像,图像合成,储层表征,碳捕集与封存,地下储氢
AI.comments: 摘要未说明网络结构细节（如生成器/判别器架构）、孔隙度条件的具体编码方式、数据划分与验证策略、对比基线方法、图像质量的定量指标（除孔隙度匹配外）、以及“81%准确率”的具体计算流程与样本规模。

title: MiniAppBench: Evaluating the Shift from Text to Interactive HTML Responses in LLM-Powered Assistants
summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) in code generation, human-AI interaction is evolving from static text responses to dynamic, interactive HTML-based applications, which we term MiniApps. These applications require models to not only render visual interfaces but also construct customized interaction logic that adheres to real-world principles. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on algorithmic correctness or static layout reconstruction, failing to capture the capabilities required for this new paradigm. To address this gap, we introduce MiniAppBench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate principle-driven, interactive application generation. Sourced from a real-world application with 10M+ generations, MiniAppBench distills 500 tasks across six domains (e.g., Games, Science, and Tools). Furthermore, to tackle the challenge of evaluating open-ended interactions where no single ground truth exists, we propose MiniAppEval, an agentic evaluation framework. Leveraging browser automation, it performs human-like exploratory testing to systematically assess applications across three dimensions: Intention, Static, and Dynamic. Our experiments reveal that current LLMs still face significant challenges in generating high-quality MiniApps, while MiniAppEval demonstrates high alignment with human judgment, establishing a reliable standard for future research. Our code is available in github.com/MiniAppBench.

AI.title_translation: MiniAppBench：评估由LLM驱动的助手从文本到交互式HTML响应的转变
AI.tldr: 提出MiniAppBench（500个真实来源任务）与MiniAppEval（基于浏览器自动化的代理式评测），用于评估LLM生成交互式HTML“MiniApp”的能力；实验显示现有LLM生成高质量MiniApp仍有明显困难，而MiniAppEval与人工评判高度一致。
AI.motivation: 人机交互正从静态文本转向可交互的HTML小应用（MiniApps），模型不仅要生成界面还要实现符合现实原则的交互逻辑；但现有基准多关注算法正确性或静态布局复原，无法覆盖这一新范式所需能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建MiniAppBench：从一个真实应用的1,000万+次生成中提炼，形成跨6个领域的500个任务（如游戏、科学、工具）。2) 提出MiniAppEval：面向无唯一标准答案的开放式交互评测，使用浏览器自动化进行类人探索式测试，并从Intention（意图满足）、Static（静态表现）、Dynamic（动态交互）三维度系统评估。
AI.result: 实验发现：当前LLM在生成高质量MiniApp方面仍面临显著挑战；MiniAppEval与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: MiniAppBench填补了“原则驱动的交互式应用生成”评测空白；MiniAppEval提供与人工对齐的可靠评测标准，可作为后续研究的基准与评估工具（代码已开源）。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面的快速进展，人机交互正在从静态文本回答演进为动态、可交互的基于HTML的应用，我们将其称为MiniApps。这类应用要求模型不仅能渲染可视化界面，还需构建遵循真实世界原则的定制化交互逻辑。然而，现有基准主要聚焦于算法正确性或静态布局重建，无法衡量这种新范式所需的能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出MiniAppBench，这是首个用于评估“原则驱动的交互式应用生成”的综合基准。MiniAppBench来源于一个真实应用（累计生成超过一千万次），并从中提炼出覆盖六个领域（如游戏、科学与工具等）的500个任务。此外，为应对开放式交互评估中不存在唯一真值的挑战，我们提出MiniAppEval，一种代理式评估框架。它借助浏览器自动化执行类人探索测试，从意图（Intention）、静态（Static）与动态（Dynamic）三个维度系统评估应用。实验表明，当前LLM在生成高质量MiniApp方面仍存在显著困难；同时，MiniAppEval与人类判断高度一致，为未来研究建立了可靠标准。代码开源于github.com/MiniAppBench。
AI.summary: 论文面向LLM生成交互式HTML小应用这一新型输出形态，发布真实数据驱动的MiniAppBench（500任务、6领域）与代理式评测MiniAppEval（浏览器自动化探索测试，按意图/静态/动态三维度评分）。结果显示现有模型能力不足，且MiniAppEval与人工评价高度一致，适合作为后续研究的标准化评测方案。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 代码生成, 交互式HTML, MiniApp, 基准测试, 代理式评测, 浏览器自动化, 探索式测试, 人类对齐评估, 开放式交互
AI.comments: 优点：真实应用来源（10M+生成）提升任务代表性；用浏览器自动化实现可扩展的交互评测，并给出三维度指标且与人工对齐。局限：具体实验设置、参评模型清单、量化指标细节与误差分析在摘要中未提及；任务许可/隐私与数据清洗策略未提及。

title: OTPL-VIO: Robust Visual-Inertial Odometry with Optimal Transport Line Association and Adaptive Uncertainty
summary: Robust stereo visual-inertial odometry (VIO) remains challenging in low-texture scenes and under abrupt illumination changes, where point features become sparse and unstable, leading to ambiguous association and under-constrained estimation. Line structures offer complementary geometric cues, yet many efficient point-line systems still rely on point-guided line association, which can break down when point support is weak and may lead to biased constraints. We present a stereo point-line VIO system in which line segments are equipped with dedicated deep descriptors and matched using an entropy-regularized optimal transport formulation, enabling globally consistent correspondences under ambiguity, outliers, and partial observations. The proposed descriptor is training-free and is computed by sampling and pooling network feature maps. To improve estimation stability, we analyze the impact of line measurement noise and introduce reliability-adaptive weighting to regulate the influence of line constraints during optimization. Experiments on EuRoC and UMA-VI, together with real-world deployments in low-texture and illumination-challenging environments, demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over representative baselines while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.title_translation: OTPL-VIO：基于最优传输线特征关联与自适应不确定性的鲁棒视觉-惯性里程计
AI.tldr: 提出一种双目点-线VIO：为线段构建免训练深度描述子，并用熵正则化最优传输做全局一致线匹配；同时引入基于可靠性的自适应加权以稳定优化，在低纹理与光照突变场景下提升精度与鲁棒性并保持实时。
AI.motivation: 低纹理与突变光照下点特征稀疏且不稳定，造成关联歧义与估计欠约束；现有高效点-线系统常依赖“点引导”的线关联，在点支持弱时易失效并引入偏置约束。
AI.method: 构建双目点-线VIO系统：1）为线段配备专用深度描述子，描述子无需训练，通过对网络特征图进行采样与池化计算；2）采用熵正则化的最优传输（Optimal Transport）进行线段匹配，实现面对歧义、离群点与部分观测时的全局一致对应；3）分析线测量噪声对估计的影响，并在优化中引入可靠性自适应权重，调节线约束的影响以提升稳定性。
AI.result: 在EuRoC与UMA-VI数据集，以及低纹理/光照挑战的真实环境部署中，相比代表性基线方法取得更高的精度与鲁棒性，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过最优传输的线关联与可靠性自适应不确定性建模，点-线双目VIO在点特征弱或环境变化剧烈时仍能获得更稳定、鲁棒且实时的里程计估计。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的双目视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）在低纹理场景和突发光照变化下仍然具有挑战性：此时点特征会变得稀少且不稳定，导致关联模糊并使估计欠约束。线结构可提供互补的几何信息，但许多高效的点-线系统仍依赖点引导的线关联；当点支持较弱时该策略会失效，并可能带来有偏的约束。我们提出一种双目点-线VIO系统：为线段配备专用的深度描述子，并采用熵正则化的最优传输框架进行匹配，从而在存在歧义、离群点和部分观测时实现全局一致的对应关系。该描述子无需训练，通过对网络特征图进行采样与池化计算得到。为提升估计稳定性，我们分析线测量噪声的影响，并引入可靠性自适应加权，在优化过程中调节线约束的作用。基于EuRoC与UMA-VI的实验，以及在低纹理与光照变化严苛的真实环境中的部署，结果表明该方法在保持实时性能的同时，相比代表性基线具有更高的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对低纹理与光照突变导致点特征不足、点引导线匹配易失效的问题，提出OTPL-VIO：使用免训练的线段深度描述子，并通过熵正则化最优传输实现鲁棒且全局一致的线段关联；同时在后端优化中依据线测量可靠性自适应调整权重以抑制噪声带来的不稳定。实验在公开数据集与真实场景验证了其在精度、鲁棒性与实时性上的综合优势。
AI.keywords: 视觉-惯性里程计; 双目VIO; 点-线特征; 线段描述子; 最优传输; 熵正则化; 数据关联; 可靠性自适应加权; 不确定性建模; 低纹理; 光照变化; 实时SLAM
AI.comments: 摘要未说明：最优传输问题的具体代价构造与求解器细节、深度特征网络来源/结构、点与线在后端的融合形式（如滑窗/滤波）、自适应权重的数学定义与估计方式、与哪些基线对比及具体数值指标。

title: Understanding the Interplay between LLMs' Utilisation of Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: A keynote at ECIR 2025
summary: Language Models (LMs) acquire parametric knowledge from their training process, embedding it within their weights. The increasing scalability of LMs, however, poses significant challenges for understanding a model's inner workings and further for updating or correcting this embedded knowledge without the significant cost of retraining. Moreover, when using these language models for knowledge-intensive language understanding tasks, LMs have to integrate relevant context, mitigating their inherent weaknesses, such as incomplete or outdated knowledge. Nevertheless, studies indicate that LMs often ignore the provided context as it can be in conflict with the pre-existing LM's memory learned during pre-training. Conflicting knowledge can also already be present in the LM's parameters, termed intra-memory conflict. This underscores the importance of understanding the interplay between how a language model uses its parametric knowledge and the retrieved contextual knowledge. In this talk, I will aim to shed light on this important issue by presenting our research on evaluating the knowledge present in LMs, diagnostic tests that can reveal knowledge conflicts, as well as on understanding the characteristics of successfully used contextual knowledge.

AI.title_translation: 理解大语言模型对参数化知识与上下文知识的利用之间的相互作用：ECIR 2025大会主旨报告
AI.tldr: 该报告关注大语言模型在使用训练所得的参数化知识与外部检索/提供的上下文知识时的相互影响与冲突。作者将介绍用于评估模型知识、诊断知识冲突，以及刻画“被成功使用的上下文知识”特征的相关研究。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型规模扩大，理解其内部知识如何存储与被调用变得困难；同时，更新/纠正模型权重中嵌入的知识代价高昂。对于知识密集型任务，模型需要结合外部上下文以弥补知识不完整或过时的问题，但研究表明模型常忽略上下文，尤其当上下文与预训练记忆冲突时；此外模型参数内部也可能存在“内存内冲突”，因此需要系统理解参数化知识与上下文知识的交互机制。
AI.method: 报告将展示作者团队的研究：1）评估语言模型中已存在知识的方法；2）能够揭示知识冲突（包括上下文与参数记忆冲突、以及参数内部的内存内冲突）的诊断测试；3）分析与理解在何种条件下上下文知识会被模型成功利用，以及这些上下文知识的特征。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 语言模型（LM）在训练过程中获得参数化知识，并将其嵌入到权重之中。然而，语言模型规模不断扩大，使得理解模型内部机制变得极具挑战，也使得在不进行高成本重训练的情况下更新或纠正这些嵌入知识更加困难。此外，在将这些语言模型用于知识密集型的语言理解任务时，模型必须整合相关上下文，以缓解其固有弱点，例如知识不完整或过时。尽管如此，研究表明语言模型往往会忽略所提供的上下文，因为上下文可能与预训练阶段学到的既有模型记忆发生冲突。相互冲突的知识也可能已经存在于模型参数中，这被称为“内存内冲突”。这凸显了理解语言模型如何使用其参数化知识与检索到的上下文知识之间相互作用的重要性。在本次报告中，我将通过展示我们关于评估语言模型中知识、揭示知识冲突的诊断测试，以及理解被成功使用的上下文知识之特征的研究，来阐明这一重要问题。
AI.summary: 本文（主旨报告摘要）提出：大语言模型的知识既来自权重中的参数化记忆，也来自任务时提供/检索的上下文，但两者可能冲突导致模型忽视上下文，且模型内部还可能存在内存内冲突。报告计划介绍一套围绕“模型知识评估—冲突诊断—上下文有效性特征分析”的研究脉络，以帮助理解并改进模型在知识密集任务中的知识整合行为。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 参数化知识, 上下文知识, 检索增强, 知识冲突, 内存内冲突, 诊断测试, 知识评估
AI.comments: 该摘要为大会报告导向，主要描述研究问题与将介绍的研究方向，未给出具体实验设置、数据集、量化结果或明确结论；“成功利用的上下文知识”的具体判定标准与特征维度在摘要中未展开。

title: When to Lock Attention: Training-Free KV Control in Video Diffusion
summary: Maintaining background consistency while enhancing foreground quality remains a core challenge in video editing. Injecting full-image information often leads to background artifacts, whereas rigid background locking severely constrains the model's capacity for foreground generation. To address this issue, we propose KV-Lock, a training-free framework tailored for DiT-based video diffusion models. Our core insight is that the hallucination metric (variance of denoising prediction) directly quantifies generation diversity, which is inherently linked to the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Building upon this, KV-Lock leverages diffusion hallucination detection to dynamically schedule two key components: the fusion ratio between cached background key-values (KVs) and newly generated KVs, and the CFG scale. When hallucination risk is detected, KV-Lock strengthens background KV locking and simultaneously amplifies conditional guidance for foreground generation, thereby mitigating artifacts and improving generation fidelity. As a training-free, plug-and-play module, KV-Lock can be easily integrated into any pre-trained DiT-based models. Extensive experiments validate that our method outperforms existing approaches in improved foreground quality with high background fidelity across various video editing tasks.

AI.title_translation: 何时锁定注意力：视频扩散中的免训练KV控制
AI.tldr: 提出KV-Lock：一种免训练、可插拔的KV缓存锁定与CFG动态调度方法，用“幻觉度量”（去噪预测方差）检测风险，在保持背景一致性的同时提升前景生成质量并减少伪影。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑中需要同时保持背景一致性并提升前景质量：注入全图信息易引入背景伪影，而刚性背景锁定又会限制模型生成高质量前景的能力。
AI.method: KV-Lock框架面向DiT类视频扩散模型，利用“幻觉度量=去噪预测方差”来量化生成多样性并与CFG尺度关联；基于扩散过程的幻觉检测动态调度两项：1）缓存背景KVs与新生成KVs的融合比例；2）CFG scale。当检测到幻觉风险时，加强背景KV锁定并同步提高条件引导以促进前景生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，KV-Lock在多种视频编辑任务上优于现有方法，实现更高的前景质量与更高的背景保真度，并减少背景伪影。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于幻觉检测的KV融合比例与CFG的动态调度，KV-Lock作为免训练、即插即用模块可集成到任意预训练DiT视频扩散模型中，有效兼顾背景一致性与前景生成质量。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文提出免训练的KV-Lock，用去噪预测方差作为幻觉风险指标，在视频扩散生成中按风险自适应调整背景KV缓存锁定强度与CFG引导强度：风险高时更锁背景并更强条件引导，从而降低背景伪影、提升前景细节与整体保真度；方法可直接插入预训练DiT视频扩散模型并在多类视频编辑任务中取得更优表现。
AI.keywords: 视频扩散; 视频编辑; DiT; 注意力KV缓存; 背景一致性; 训练无关(免训练); classifier-free guidance; 幻觉检测; 动态调度; 伪影抑制
AI.comments: 抽象未说明具体实现细节（如KV缓存来源、调度策略形式/阈值、计算开销）、实验设定（数据集、任务类型、对比方法、指标）以及定量提升幅度；“translation”相关信息未在摘要中给出。

title: Proportionality Degree in Participatory Budgeting
summary: We initiate the study of the proportionality degree for participatory budgeting, with a particular focus on two popular methods: the Method of Equal Shares (MES) and Phragmen's Sequential Rule. Among other results, we derive tight bounds (up to small constant factors) on the proportionality degree of these two rules, which showcase that, despite MES satisfying stronger axiomatic guarantees, the two rules have the same proportionality degree from a quantitative perspective. We complement our theoretical findings with an extensive experimental evaluation on real-world participatory budgeting datasets, the results of which closely mirror those of our developed theory. Our experiments also provide more insights into the comparisons between the rules.

AI.title_translation: 参与式预算中的比例性程度
AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究参与式预算（PB）中的“比例性程度”指标，针对MES与Phragmén顺序规则给出（至多差小常数因子）紧的比例性程度界，并通过真实数据实验验证：尽管MES具备更强的公理性质，两者在该量化指标上表现同等。
AI.motivation: 在参与式预算中，现有规则的公理保证（如MES更强）未必能反映其“比例性”在量化层面的差异，因此需要提出并比较可量化的比例性衡量指标，并评估主流规则在该指标下的表现。
AI.method: 1) 引入/发起对PB中“比例性程度”（proportionality degree）的系统研究；2) 理论分析MES与Phragmén顺序规则，推导其比例性程度的紧界（允许小常数因子差距）；3) 在真实世界PB数据集上进行大规模实验评估，对比并验证理论结论，并提供额外比较洞见。
AI.result: 给出了MES与Phragmén顺序规则在比例性程度上的紧界（到小常数因子），并显示两种规则在该量化意义下具有相同的比例性程度；实验结果与理论高度一致，并进一步揭示两规则间的比较信息。
AI.conclusion: 尽管MES在公理层面满足更强的保证，但从“比例性程度”这一量化视角看，MES与Phragmén顺序规则的比例性表现相同；真实数据实验支持并印证了该理论结论。
AI.translation: 我们开启了对参与式预算中比例性程度的研究，特别关注两种流行方法：等份法（MES）与Phragmén顺序规则。除其他结果外，我们推导了这两种规则的比例性程度的紧界（最多相差小的常数因子），表明尽管MES满足更强的公理性保证，但从量化角度看，两种规则具有相同的比例性程度。我们还在真实世界的参与式预算数据集上进行了广泛的实验评估，实验结果与我们建立的理论高度一致。实验也为两种规则的比较提供了更多洞见。
AI.summary: 论文以参与式预算为背景，提出用“比例性程度”来量化评估预算分配规则的比例性，并对MES与Phragmén顺序规则进行理论界限推导与真实数据实验对照。核心发现是：虽然MES在规范性（公理）方面更强，但在该量化比例性指标上并不优于Phragmén顺序规则，两者基本等同，且实验与理论相互印证。
AI.keywords: 参与式预算; 比例性程度; Method of Equal Shares (MES); Phragmén顺序规则; 比例性; 社会选择; 实证评估; 理论界限
AI.comments: 摘要未说明：比例性程度的正式定义、所用数据集名称与规模、实验指标与设置细节、紧界的具体形式与常数、以及“更强公理保证”具体指哪些公理。

title: FreqCycle: A Multi-Scale Time-Frequency Analysis Method for Time Series Forecasting
comments: 18 pages, 17 figures, accepted to AAAI 2026. Code available at https://github.com/boya-zhang-ai/FreqCycle
summary: Mining time-frequency features is critical for time series forecasting. Existing research has predominantly focused on modeling low-frequency patterns, where most time series energy is concentrated. The overlooking of mid to high frequency continues to limit further performance gains in deep learning models. We propose FreqCycle, a novel framework integrating: (i) a Filter-Enhanced Cycle Forecasting (FECF) module to extract low-frequency features by explicitly learning shared periodic patterns in the time domain, and (ii) a Segmented Frequency-domain Pattern Learning (SFPL) module to enhance mid to high frequency energy proportion via learnable filters and adaptive weighting. Furthermore, time series data often exhibit coupled multi-periodicity, such as intertwined weekly and daily cycles. To address coupled multi-periodicity as well as long lookback window challenges, we extend FreqCycle hierarchically into MFreqCycle, which decouples nested periodic features through cross-scale interactions. Extensive experiments on seven diverse domain benchmarks demonstrate that FreqCycle achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while maintaining faster inference speeds, striking an optimal balance between performance and efficiency.
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, accepted to AAAI 2026. Code available at https://github.com/boya-zhang-ai/FreqCycle

AI.title_translation: FreqCycle：用于时间序列预测的多尺度时频分析方法
AI.tldr: 提出FreqCycle/ MFreqCycle，通过时域周期学习提取低频特征，并在频域用可学习滤波与自适应加权增强中高频信息；在7个基准上达成SOTA精度且推理更快。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法主要建模低频模式，忽视中高频信息，限制深度模型进一步提升；同时真实数据存在耦合多周期性（如周/日交织）与长回看窗口带来的建模困难。
AI.method: FreqCycle框架包含两部分：(i) FECF（Filter-Enhanced Cycle Forecasting）模块：在时域显式学习共享周期模式以提取低频特征；(ii) SFPL（Segmented Frequency-domain Pattern Learning）模块：在频域通过可学习滤波器与自适应加权提升中高频能量占比并学习对应模式。进一步提出层次化扩展MFreqCycle，通过跨尺度交互解耦嵌套/耦合的多周期特征，以应对耦合多周期性与长lookback窗口问题。
AI.result: 在7个不同领域的基准数据集上进行大量实验，FreqCycle取得最先进（SOTA）预测精度，同时保持更快的推理速度，在性能与效率之间实现更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时频建模（低频周期+中高频增强）能显著提升时间序列预测；层次化的MFreqCycle可通过跨尺度交互解耦耦合多周期特征，并兼顾长窗口建模与推理效率。
AI.translation: 挖掘时频特征对时间序列预测至关重要。现有研究主要聚焦于建模低频模式，因为大多数时间序列能量集中在低频。对中高频的忽视限制了深度学习模型进一步提升性能。我们提出FreqCycle，这是一种新框架，集成：(i) 滤波增强的周期预测（FECF）模块，通过在时间域显式学习共享的周期模式来提取低频特征；(ii) 分段频域模式学习（SFPL）模块，通过可学习滤波器与自适应加权来提升中高频能量占比，从而增强中高频模式学习。此外，时间序列数据常呈现耦合的多周期性，例如周周期与日周期交织。为解决耦合多周期性以及长回看窗口带来的挑战，我们将FreqCycle层次化扩展为MFreqCycle，通过跨尺度交互解耦嵌套的周期特征。在七个不同领域基准上的大量实验表明，FreqCycle在保持更快推理速度的同时实现了最先进的准确率，在性能与效率之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.summary: 该工作针对深度时间序列预测中过度关注低频、忽略中高频导致的性能瓶颈，提出FreqCycle：用FECF在时域显式学习共享周期以捕获低频结构，用SFPL在频域通过可学习滤波与自适应权重增强并学习中高频模式；同时提出层次化MFreqCycle，利用跨尺度交互解耦周/日等耦合多周期并缓解长回看窗口建模难题。实验在7个基准上显示其精度达SOTA且推理更快，兼顾效果与效率。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测; 时频分析; 多尺度建模; 低频周期模式; 中高频增强; 可学习滤波器; 频域学习; 多周期性解耦; 层次化模型; 推理效率
AI.comments: 创新点在于将时域显式周期学习与频域分段的中高频增强结合，并通过层次化跨尺度交互处理耦合多周期性；优势是同时提升准确率与推理速度。局限与细节（如具体网络结构、损失函数、复杂度、消融结果与适用边界）在摘要中未提及。

title: No evaluation without fair representation : Impact of label and selection bias on the evaluation, performance and mitigation of classification models
comments: 31 pages, 14 figures + appendix Submitted to the ACM Journal on Responsible Computing
summary: Bias can be introduced in diverse ways in machine learning datasets, for example via selection or label bias. Although these bias types in themselves have an influence on important aspects of fair machine learning, their different impact has been understudied. In this work, we empirically analyze the effect of label bias and several subtypes of selection bias on the evaluation of classification models, on their performance, and on the effectiveness of bias mitigation methods. We also introduce a biasing and evaluation framework that allows to model fair worlds and their biased counterparts through the introduction of controlled bias in real-life datasets with low discrimination. Using our framework, we empirically analyze the impact of each bias type independently, while obtaining a more representative evaluation of models and mitigation methods than with the traditional use of a subset of biased data as test set. Our results highlight different factors that influence how impactful bias is on model performance. They also show an absence of trade-off between fairness and accuracy, and between individual and group fairness, when models are evaluated on a test set that does not exhibit unwanted bias. They furthermore indicate that the performance of bias mitigation methods is influenced by the type of bias present in the data. Our findings call for future work to develop more accurate evaluations of prediction models and fairness interventions, but also to better understand other types of bias, more complex scenarios involving the combination of different bias types, and other factors that impact the efficiency of the mitigation methods, such as dataset characteristics.
comment: 31 pages, 14 figures + appendix Submitted to the ACM Journal on Responsible Computing

AI.title_translation: 没有公平表征就没有评估：标签偏差与选择偏差对分类模型评估、性能与缓解方法的影响
AI.tldr: 论文系统比较标签偏差与多种选择偏差对分类模型评估、模型性能及偏差缓解方法有效性的影响，并提出一个可在低歧视真实数据上可控注入偏差、构造“公平世界/有偏世界”的评估框架；结果表明测试集若不含不期望偏差，则公平性与准确率、个体公平与群体公平之间不必然存在权衡，且缓解方法效果依赖偏差类型。
AI.motivation: 机器学习数据中会因选择偏差或标签偏差引入偏差，但不同偏差类型对公平机器学习关键方面的差异化影响研究不足；同时传统用“有偏数据子集”作测试集可能导致不具代表性的评估，因此需要更准确、可控的评估方式来理解偏差与缓解方法的真实效果。
AI.method: 1) 实证分析：分别研究标签偏差与若干选择偏差子类型对分类模型评估、性能与偏差缓解方法有效性的影响；2) 提出“偏置与评估框架”：在具有低歧视的真实数据集上通过可控方式注入偏差，构建公平世界及其有偏对应体，从而能独立分析各类偏差，并用无不期望偏差的测试集获得更具代表性的模型与缓解方法评估。
AI.result: 1) 不同因素会影响偏差对模型性能的影响程度；2) 当在不含不期望偏差的测试集上评估时，观察到公平性与准确率之间、以及个体公平与群体公平之间不存在权衡；3) 偏差缓解方法的表现受数据中偏差类型影响。
AI.conclusion: 需要未来工作：发展更准确的预测模型与公平干预评估方法；进一步理解其他偏差类型；研究多种偏差类型组合的更复杂情景；并考察如数据集特性等影响缓解方法效率的因素。
AI.translation: 偏差可通过多种方式引入机器学习数据集，例如选择偏差或标签偏差。尽管这些偏差类型本身会影响公平机器学习的重要方面，但它们的不同影响仍缺乏充分研究。本文通过实证方式分析标签偏差以及若干选择偏差子类型对分类模型评估、模型性能以及偏差缓解方法有效性的影响。我们还提出一种偏置与评估框架，可通过在歧视程度较低的真实数据集中引入可控偏差，来同时建模公平世界及其有偏对应体。利用该框架，我们能够独立分析每种偏差类型的影响，并相比传统将有偏数据子集用作测试集的做法，获得对模型与缓解方法更具代表性的评估。结果凸显了影响偏差对模型性能作用大小的不同因素；并表明当模型在不呈现不期望偏差的测试集上评估时，公平性与准确率之间、以及个体公平与群体公平之间不存在权衡；同时还表明偏差缓解方法的表现受数据中偏差类型影响。我们的发现呼吁未来工作开发更准确的预测模型与公平干预评估，并更好理解其他偏差类型、更复杂的多偏差组合场景，以及诸如数据集特性等影响缓解方法效率的因素。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦两类常见数据偏差（标签偏差与选择偏差及其子类型）如何分别扭曲分类模型的评估结论、影响模型性能，并改变偏差缓解方法的有效性。作者提出一个可在低歧视真实数据上“可控注入偏差”的评估框架，用以构造公平世界与对应的有偏世界，从而避免用有偏测试集带来的不具代表性评估。实证结果显示：偏差影响程度取决于多种因素；在无不期望偏差的测试集上评估时，公平-准确率与个体-群体公平不必然存在权衡；且缓解方法的效果会随偏差类型而变化。
AI.keywords: 公平机器学习; 标签偏差; 选择偏差; 分类模型评估; 偏差缓解; 公平性评估框架; 个体公平; 群体公平; 准确率-公平权衡
AI.comments: 贡献点：区分并独立研究标签偏差与选择偏差子类型的影响；提出在真实数据上可控构造公平/有偏世界的评估框架以提升评估代表性。局限与待补充信息：未在摘要中说明具体数据集、模型、偏差缓解算法、偏差子类型的精确定义与注入方式、度量指标及量化结果幅度；未来方向在摘要中已指出（多偏差组合、更多偏差类型、数据集特性对缓解效率影响）。

title: A Least-Squares-Based Regularity-Conforming Neural Networks (LS-ReCoNNs) for Solving Parametric Transmission Problems
comments: 33 pages, 18 figures. Funded by: EU Horizon Europe MSCA-DN-101119556 (IN-DEEP); MICIU/AEI PID2023-146678OB-I00 & CEX2021-001142-S; Basque Govt BERC 2022-2025, ELKARTEK (KK-2023/00012, KK-2024/00086), MATHMODE (IT1866-26); and NextGenerationEU/PRTR
summary: This article focuses on solving parametric transmission problems in one and two spatial dimensions. These problems belong to a class of partial differential equations that arise in the modeling of physical systems with heterogeneous materials. They often exhibit discontinuities across interfaces and singularities at points where interfaces intersect. To address these problems, we propose a new deep learning approach named {\it{Least-Squares-Based Regularity-Conforming Neural Network (LS-ReCoNN)}}. This approach proposes a loss function that is shown to be a consistent upper bound for the energy-norm error. The method represents the solution as the sum of a principal component and a singular component. The principal component is decomposed into smooth and gradient-jump parts, which capture both the regular solution behavior and reduced regularity across interfaces in one- and two-dimensional problems. The singular component is introduced to model junction singularities and it is approximated using basis functions computed from a one-dimensional finite element eigenvalue problem. For the principal component, a separated representation is employed, consisting of parameter-dependent coefficients and space-dependent functions. A deep neural network approximates the space-dependent functions, while the parameter-dependent coefficients are determined by a least-squares solver, where the optimal coefficients for each parameter instance are obtained online by solving a low-dimensional least-squares problem. Numerical experiments in one and two dimensions demonstrate that LS-ReCoNN effectively captures singularities while maintaining solution accuracy across a wide range of parameter values.

AI.title_translation: 用于求解参数化传输问题的基于最小二乘的正则性一致神经网络（LS-ReCoNNs）
AI.tldr: 提出LS-ReCoNN：用能量范数误差一致上界的最小二乘损失，并将解分解为主成分（含光滑与梯度跳跃部分）与奇异成分（用1D有限元特征问题基函数逼近），在1D/2D参数化传输问题上能有效刻画界面不连续与交汇点奇异性且保持全参数范围精度。
AI.motivation: 参数化传输问题在异质材料建模中常见，解在界面处有不连续、在界面交汇处有奇异性，导致传统方法或直接神经网络逼近难以兼顾全参数范围的精度与奇异结构刻画。
AI.method: 提出LS-ReCoNN方法：1）构造损失函数，证明其为能量范数误差的“一致上界”；2）解表示为主成分+奇异成分；3）主成分再分为光滑部分与梯度跳跃部分，用于捕捉规则行为与界面降阶正则性；4）奇异成分用于建模交汇点奇异性，采用由一维有限元特征值问题计算得到的基函数来逼近；5）主成分采用分离表示：参数相关系数+空间相关函数；6）空间相关函数由深度神经网络逼近，参数相关系数通过最小二乘求解；7）在线阶段对每个参数实例求解一个低维最小二乘问题得到最优系数。
AI.result: 在一维与二维数值实验中，LS-ReCoNN在宽参数范围内能够有效捕捉奇异性，同时保持解的准确性，并在界面处维持良好的精度表现。
AI.conclusion: LS-ReCoNN通过“正则性一致”的分解表示与最小二乘在线系数求解，将界面跳跃与交汇奇异性显式纳入模型，并使用能量范数误差一致上界的损失实现稳定训练，从而有效求解1D/2D参数化传输问题。
AI.translation: 本文聚焦于求解一维与二维空间中的参数化传输问题。这类问题属于偏微分方程，常见于含异质材料的物理系统建模，通常在界面处出现不连续，并在界面相交点产生奇异性。为此，我们提出一种新的深度学习方法：基于最小二乘的正则性一致神经网络（LS-ReCoNN）。该方法设计的损失函数可证明为能量范数误差的一致上界。方法将解表示为主成分与奇异成分之和。主成分进一步分解为光滑部分与梯度跳跃部分，用于在一维与二维问题中同时捕捉规则解行为与界面处的正则性降低。奇异成分用于刻画交汇点奇异性，并采用由一维有限元特征值问题计算得到的基函数进行逼近。针对主成分，采用分离表示：参数相关系数与空间相关函数。空间相关函数由深度神经网络逼近，而参数相关系数由最小二乘求解器确定：对每个参数实例，可在线求解一个低维最小二乘问题以获得最优系数。一维与二维数值实验表明，LS-ReCoNN能够有效捕捉奇异性，并在广泛的参数取值范围内保持解的精度。
AI.summary: 该论文面向含界面不连续与交汇点奇异性的参数化传输PDE，提出LS-ReCoNN框架：以能量范数误差一致上界为训练目标，将解拆分为（光滑+梯度跳跃）的主成分与基于FE特征基函数的奇异成分；主成分采用参数-空间分离表示，空间函数用DNN学习，参数系数通过在线低维最小二乘快速求得。实验显示方法在1D/2D与宽参数域下能同时保证奇异结构刻画与整体精度。
AI.keywords: 参数化传输问题; 界面不连续; 交汇点奇异性; 正则性一致; 最小二乘损失; 能量范数误差上界; 解分解; 分离表示; 深度神经网络; 有限元特征值问题; 在线低维最小二乘
AI.comments: 创新点在于：将PDE解的正则性结构（界面梯度跳跃与交汇奇异）显式分解并纳入网络表示；用可证明为能量范数误差一致上界的损失增强训练与误差控制；采用“空间函数由DNN学习+参数系数在线最小二乘”的混合策略以提升跨参数泛化与在线效率。局限与细节（网络结构、数据生成、训练设置、复杂几何/更高维扩展、理论误差界的具体条件等）在摘要中未提及。

title: DiffWind: Physics-Informed Differentiable Modeling of Wind-Driven Object Dynamics
comments: Accepted by ICLR 2026. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/DiffWind/
summary: Modeling wind-driven object dynamics from video observations is highly challenging due to the invisibility and spatio-temporal variability of wind, as well as the complex deformations of objects. We present DiffWind, a physics-informed differentiable framework that unifies wind-object interaction modeling, video-based reconstruction, and forward simulation. Specifically, we represent wind as a grid-based physical field and objects as particle systems derived from 3D Gaussian Splatting, with their interaction modeled by the Material Point Method (MPM). To recover wind-driven object dynamics, we introduce a reconstruction framework that jointly optimizes the spatio-temporal wind force field and object motion through differentiable rendering and simulation. To ensure physical validity, we incorporate the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) as a physics-informed constraint, enforcing compliance with fluid dynamics laws. Beyond reconstruction, our method naturally supports forward simulation under novel wind conditions and enables new applications such as wind retargeting. We further introduce WD-Objects, a dataset of synthetic and real-world wind-driven scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms prior dynamic scene modeling approaches in both reconstruction accuracy and simulation fidelity, opening a new avenue for video-based wind-object interaction modeling.

title: Embedded Model Predictive Control for EMS-type Maglev Vehicles
summary: Current developments of high-speed magnetic levitation technology using the principle of the electromagnet suspension (EMS) focus on reaching vehicle speeds of more than 600 km/h. With increasing vehicle speeds, however, updated control algorithms need to be investigated to reliably stabilize the system and meet the demands in terms of ride comfort. This article examines the modern and popular approach of model predictive control and its application to the magnetic levitation control system. Investigated key aspects are the parameterization of the model predictive controller and its implementation on embedded, resource constrained hardware. The results reveal that model predictive control is capable to robustly stabilize the highly nonlinear and constrained system even at very high speed. Furthermore, processor-in-the-loop studies are carried out to validate the designed control algorithms on a microcontroller.

title: VarSplat: Uncertainty-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Robust RGB-D SLAM
summary: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables fast, differentiable rendering and high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse real-world scenes. However, existing 3DGS-SLAM approaches handle measurement reliability implicitly, making pose estimation and global alignment susceptible to drift in low-texture regions, transparent surfaces, or areas with complex reflectance properties. To this end, we introduce VarSplat, an uncertainty-aware 3DGS-SLAM system that explicitly learns per-splat appearance variance. By using the law of total variance with alpha compositing, we then render differentiable per-pixel uncertainty map via efficient, single-pass rasterization. This map guides tracking, submap registration, and loop detection toward focusing on reliable regions and contributes to more stable optimization. Experimental results on Replica (synthetic) and TUM-RGBD, ScanNet, and ScanNet++ (real-world) show that VarSplat improves robustness and achieves competitive or superior tracking, mapping, and novel view synthesis rendering compared to existing studies for dense RGB-D SLAM.

AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并渲染不确定性、将其用于SLAM关键模块的优化与匹配，VarSplat能在具有挑战的真实场景中减少漂移并提升3DGS-SLAM的稳定性与整体性能。

title: GNNs for Time Series Anomaly Detection: An Open-Source Framework and a Critical Evaluation
summary: There is growing interest in applying graph-based methods to Time Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD), particularly Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), as they naturally model dependencies among multivariate signals. GNNs are typically used as backbones in score-based TSAD pipelines, where anomalies are identified through reconstruction or prediction errors followed by thresholding. However, and despite promising results, the field still lacks standardized frameworks for evaluation and suffers from persistent issues with metric design and interpretation. We thus present an open-source framework for TSAD using GNNs, designed to support reproducible experimentation across datasets, graph structures, and evaluation strategies. Built with flexibility and extensibility in mind, the framework facilitates systematic comparisons between TSAD models and enables in-depth analysis of performance and interpretability. Using this tool, we evaluate several GNN-based architectures alongside baseline models across two real-world datasets with contrasting structural characteristics. Our results show that GNNs not only improve detection performance but also offer significant gains in interpretability, an especially valuable feature for practical diagnosis. We also find that attention-based GNNs offer robustness when graph structure is uncertain or inferred. In addition, we reflect on common evaluation practices in TSAD, showing how certain metrics and thresholding strategies can obscure meaningful comparisons. Overall, this work contributes both practical tools and critical insights to advance the development and evaluation of graph-based TSAD systems.

title: Logics-Parsing-Omni Technical Report
summary: Addressing the challenges of fragmented task definitions and the heterogeneity of unstructured data in multimodal parsing, this paper proposes the Omni Parsing framework. This framework establishes a Unified Taxonomy covering documents, images, and audio-visual streams, introducing a progressive parsing paradigm that bridges perception and cognition. Specifically, the framework integrates three hierarchical levels: 1) Holistic Detection, which achieves precise spatial-temporal grounding of objects or events to establish a geometric baseline for perception; 2) Fine-grained Recognition, which performs symbolization (e.g., OCR/ASR) and attribute extraction on localized objects to complete structured entity parsing; and 3) Multi-level Interpreting, which constructs a reasoning chain from local semantics to global logic. A pivotal advantage of this framework is its evidence anchoring mechanism, which enforces a strict alignment between high-level semantic descriptions and low-level facts. This enables ``evidence-based'' logical induction, transforming unstructured signals into standardized knowledge that is locatable, enumerable, and traceable. Building on this foundation, we constructed a standardized dataset and released the Logics-Parsing-Omni model, which successfully converts complex audio-visual signals into machine-readable structured knowledge. Experiments demonstrate that fine-grained perception and high-level cognition are synergistic, effectively enhancing model reliability. Furthermore, to quantitatively evaluate these capabilities, we introduce OmniParsingBench. Code, models and the benchmark are released at https://github.com/alibaba/Logics-Parsing/tree/master/Logics-Parsing-Omni.

AI.comments: 贡献集中在框架化与可评测性：提出统一 taxonomy 与三层级流水线，并用证据锚定约束“可解释/可追溯”的语义输出；同时配套发布模型、数据集与基准。局限是摘要未说明数据集规模、任务设置细节、对比方法与具体实验指标。

title: EsoLang-Bench: Evaluating Genuine Reasoning in Large Language Models via Esoteric Programming Languages
summary: Large language models achieve near-ceiling performance on code generation benchmarks, yet these results increasingly reflect memorization rather than genuine reasoning. We introduce EsoLang-Bench, a benchmark using five esoteric programming languages (Brainfuck, Befunge-98, Whitespace, Unlambda, and Shakespeare) that lack benchmark gaming incentives due to their economic irrationality for pre-training. These languages require the same computational primitives as mainstream programming but have 1,000-100,000x fewer public repositories than Python (based on GitHub search counts). We evaluate five frontier models across five prompting strategies and find a dramatic capability gap: models achieving 85-95% on standard benchmarks score only 0-11% on equivalent esoteric tasks, with 0% accuracy beyond the Easy tier. Few-shot learning and self-reflection fail to improve performance, suggesting these techniques exploit training priors rather than enabling genuine learning. EsoLang-Bench provides the first benchmark designed to mimic human learning by acquiring new languages through documentation, interpreter feedback, and iterative experimentation, measuring transferable reasoning skills resistant to data contamination.

AI.title_translation: EsoLang-Bench：通过深奥（另类）编程语言评估大语言模型中的真实推理能力
AI.tldr: 提出一个基于五种深奥编程语言的基准EsoLang-Bench，以降低数据污染与“刷榜”动机；实验显示前沿模型在常规代码基准高分，但在等价的深奥语言任务上仅0–11%，且在Easy以上为0%，少样本与自我反思无效，表明现有高分更多来自记忆而非可迁移推理。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准接近“天花板”，但成绩越来越可能源于记忆与训练数据污染，而非真实推理；需要一种更难被预训练覆盖、能更像人类学习新语言的评测来检验可迁移的推理/学习能力。
AI.method: 构建EsoLang-Bench，选用Brainfuck、Befunge-98、Whitespace、Unlambda、Shakespeare五种深奥语言（公共代码库远少于Python，按GitHub检索约少1,000–100,000倍），在五个前沿模型与五种提示策略下评测；任务与主流语言具备相同计算原语，并强调通过文档、解释器反馈与迭代试验来“学习语言”的设置。
AI.result: 出现显著能力鸿沟：在标准基准达85–95%的模型，在等价深奥语言任务上仅0–11%；在Easy以上难度准确率为0%；少样本学习与自我反思未带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 常见提升手段（少样本、自我反思）可能主要利用训练先验而非实现真正学习；EsoLang-Bench更能抵抗数据污染，提供用于衡量可迁移推理与类人学习的新基准。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在代码生成基准上已接近满分，但这些结果越来越多地反映出记忆而非真实推理。我们提出EsoLang-Bench，这是一个使用五种深奥编程语言（Brainfuck、Befunge-98、Whitespace、Unlambda和Shakespeare）的基准。由于这些语言在预训练中缺乏“刷榜”经济动机，它们更不易被针对性利用。它们需要与主流编程相同的计算原语，但在公共代码仓库中相比Python少1,000到100,000倍（基于GitHub搜索计数）。我们在五种提示策略下评估了五个前沿模型，发现显著能力差距：在标准基准上达到85–95%的模型，在等价的深奥语言任务上仅得0–11%，且在Easy难度以上准确率为0%。少样本学习与自我反思无法提升表现，表明这些技术更多在利用训练先验而非实现真实学习。EsoLang-Bench是首个旨在模拟人类学习的基准：通过文档、解释器反馈与迭代实验来习得新语言，从而测量对数据污染更具鲁棒性的可迁移推理能力。
AI.summary: 本文用深奥编程语言构造代码生成/推理评测，以削弱预训练记忆与数据污染对分数的影响。通过在多模型、多提示策略下对等价任务进行比较，作者发现模型在主流代码基准的高分无法迁移到低资源深奥语言环境，且常用的少样本与自我反思策略也难以带来改进，从而支持“现有高分偏记忆、真实可迁移推理不足”的观点，并给出一种更贴近人类从文档与反馈中学习新语言的评测框架。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；代码生成；真实推理；基准测试；深奥编程语言；数据污染；可迁移学习；提示策略；Brainfuck；Befunge-98；Whitespace；Unlambda；Shakespeare
AI.comments: 优点：通过选择低资源、低经济动机的语言降低训练覆盖与刷榜空间；将“从文档与解释器反馈学习”纳入评测更贴近类人学习。局限（摘要未给细节）：未说明具体任务形式、数据规模、评分方式与“等价任务”如何构造；“五个前沿模型/五种提示策略”的具体名单与设置未在摘要展开；GitHub计数作为数据稀缺性代理可能受噪声影响。

title: Improving 3D Foot Motion Reconstruction in Markerless Monocular Human Motion Capture
comments: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV)
summary: State-of-the-art methods can recover accurate overall 3D human body motion from in-the-wild videos. However, they often fail to capture fine-grained articulations, especially in the feet, which are critical for applications such as gait analysis and animation. This limitation results from training datasets with inaccurate foot annotations and limited foot motion diversity. We address this gap with FootMR, a Foot Motion Refinement method that refines foot motion estimated by an existing human recovery model through lifting 2D foot keypoint sequences to 3D. By avoiding direct image input, FootMR circumvents inaccurate image-3D annotation pairs and can instead leverage large-scale motion capture data. To resolve ambiguities of 2D-to-3D lifting, FootMR incorporates knee and foot motion as context and predicts only residual foot motion. Generalization to extreme foot poses is further improved by representing joints in global rather than parent-relative rotations and applying extensive data augmentation. To support evaluation of foot motion reconstruction, we introduce MOOF, a 2D dataset of complex foot movements. Experiments on MOOF, MOYO, and RICH show that FootMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing ankle joint angle error on MOYO by up to 30% over the best video-based approach.
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV)

AI.title_translation: 在无标记单目人体动作捕捉中提升三维足部运动重建
AI.tldr: 提出FootMR：通过将2D足部关键点序列提升到3D并预测残差来细化现有人体重建模型的足部运动；同时发布MOOF数据集用于评测，实验显示在多数据集上显著降低足踝角度误差（MOYO上最高降30%）。
AI.motivation: 现有野外视频中的3D人体动作恢复整体准确，但足部等细粒度关节常失败；原因在于训练数据足部标注不准且足部动作多样性不足，影响步态分析与动画等应用。
AI.method: FootMR足部运动细化方法：以现有人体恢复模型输出为基础，不直接使用图像，而是将2D足部关键点序列进行2D-to-3D提升；为消除提升歧义，引入膝部与足部运动作为上下文，并仅预测足部运动的残差；为提升对极端足姿的泛化，使用全局（非父子相对）关节旋转表示并进行大量数据增强；可利用大规模动作捕捉数据进行训练。
AI.result: 在MOOF、MOYO、RICH上的实验表明FootMR优于SOTA方法；在MOYO上相对最佳视频方法，踝关节角度误差最多降低约30%。
AI.conclusion: 通过绕开图像到3D的噪声标注对、改用2D关键点序列提升并预测残差，结合上下文信息、全局旋转表示与数据增强，能够显著提升单目无标记场景下的足部3D运动重建质量；MOOF数据集为复杂足部运动评测提供支持。

title: On Catastrophic Forgetting in Low-Rank Decomposition-Based Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) based on low-rank decomposition, such as LoRA, has become a standard for adapting large pretrained models. However, its behavior in sequential learning -- specifically regarding catastrophic forgetting -- remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present an empirical study showing that forgetting is strongly influenced by the geometry and parameterization of the update subspace. While methods that restrict updates to small, shared matrix subspaces often suffer from task interference, tensor-based decompositions (e.g., LoRETTA) mitigate forgetting by capturing richer structural information within ultra-compact budgets, and structurally aligned parameterizations (e.g., WeGeFT) preserve pretrained representations. Our findings highlight update subspace design as a key factor in continual learning and offer practical guidance for selecting efficient adaptation strategies in sequential settings.

AI.title_translation: 关于基于低秩分解的参数高效微调中的灾难性遗忘
AI.tldr: 论文通过实证研究指出：在顺序/持续学习中，低秩分解类PEFT（如LoRA）的灾难性遗忘主要受“更新子空间”的几何与参数化方式影响；共享小矩阵子空间更易任务干扰，而张量分解（LoRETTA）与结构对齐参数化（WeGeFT）可在超紧凑预算下缓解遗忘并更好保留预训练表征。
AI.motivation: 低秩分解PEFT已成为适配大模型的常用方案，但其在顺序学习场景下的灾难性遗忘机理与影响因素仍不清楚，需要系统分析并给出实践选型指导。
AI.method: 进行实证研究，从“更新子空间的几何与参数化”角度对比不同低秩/分解式PEFT在顺序学习中的表现：包括限制在小型共享矩阵子空间的做法（如LoRA类）、张量分解方法（如LoRETTA）以及结构对齐的参数化方式（如WeGeFT），观察任务干扰与遗忘程度差异。
AI.result: 遗忘强烈受更新子空间的几何与参数化影响；限制更新到小且共享的矩阵子空间的方法往往出现更明显的任务干扰与遗忘；张量分解（LoRETTA）能在超紧凑参数预算下通过捕获更丰富结构信息来缓解遗忘；结构对齐参数化（WeGeFT）有助于保留预训练表征，从而减轻遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 更新子空间设计是顺序/持续学习中决定遗忘的重要因素；在需要连续适配的场景，应优先考虑能表达更丰富结构或与预训练结构对齐的PEFT参数化，以在高效预算下减少灾难性遗忘。
AI.translation: 基于低秩分解的参数高效微调（PEFT），例如 LoRA，已成为适配大型预训练模型的标准方法。然而，其在顺序学习中的行为——尤其是关于灾难性遗忘——仍缺乏充分理解。本文给出一项实证研究，表明遗忘会受到更新子空间的几何性质与参数化方式的强烈影响。将更新限制在较小、共享的矩阵子空间中的方法往往会遭受任务间干扰；而张量分解方法（例如 LoRETTA）能够在超紧凑的预算下，通过捕获更丰富的结构信息来缓解遗忘；结构对齐的参数化方式（例如 WeGeFT）则能保留预训练表征。我们的发现强调：更新子空间的设计是持续学习中的关键因素，并为在顺序设置中选择高效适配策略提供了实践指导。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦低秩分解PEFT在顺序学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出遗忘差异的核心来源在于“参数更新被限制到何种子空间”以及该子空间的参数化方式。实证结果显示：共享且过小的矩阵更新子空间更易引发任务干扰；张量分解可在极小参数开销下提升结构表达，从而降低遗忘；与预训练结构更一致的参数化有助于维持原有表征。论文据此强调持续学习中应将更新子空间设计作为关键设计维度，并为PEFT方法选型提供经验性建议。
AI.keywords: 参数高效微调; 低秩分解; LoRA; 灾难性遗忘; 顺序学习; 持续学习; 更新子空间; 几何; 张量分解; LoRETTA; WeGeFT; 任务干扰; 表征保持
AI.comments: 本文为实证研究，主要贡献在于提出并验证“更新子空间几何/参数化影响遗忘”的视角并给出方法对比；具体实验设置、数据集、评价指标与定量结果在摘要中Not mentioned in abstract。

title: Automatic Cardiac Risk Management Classification using large-context Electronic Patients Health Records
summary: To overcome the limitations of manual administrative coding in geriatric Cardiovascular Risk Management, this study introduces an automated classification framework leveraging unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHRs). Using a dataset of 3,482 patients, we benchmarked three distinct modeling paradigms on longitudinal Dutch clinical narratives: classical machine learning baselines, specialized deep learning architectures optimized for large-context sequences, and general-purpose generative Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting. Additionally, we evaluated a late fusion strategy to integrate unstructured text with structured medication embeddings and anthropometric data. Our analysis reveals that the custom Transformer architecture outperforms both traditional methods and generative \acs{llm}s, achieving the highest F1-scores and Matthews Correlation Coefficients. These findings underscore the critical role of specialized hierarchical attention mechanisms in capturing long-range dependencies within medical texts, presenting a robust, automated alternative to manual workflows for clinical risk stratification.

AI.title_translation: 利用大上下文电子患者健康记录的自动心脏风险管理分类
AI.tldr: 基于3,482名患者的荷兰纵向临床叙事EHR，比较传统机器学习、面向长序列的专用深度模型与零样本LLM，并结合结构化用药与人体测量数据的后期融合；结果显示定制Transformer（层级注意力）在F1与MCC上最佳，优于传统方法与零样本LLM，可替代人工编码进行心血管风险管理分层。
AI.motivation: 手工行政编码在老年心血管风险管理中存在局限性，需一种基于EHR的自动化分类方案以提升效率与一致性。
AI.method: 在3,482名患者的非结构化、纵向荷兰临床叙事EHR上，基准评测三类范式：①经典机器学习基线；②针对大上下文序列优化的专用深度学习架构（含定制Transformer/层级注意力）；③通用生成式LLM的零样本分类；并评估后期融合（late fusion）以整合非结构化文本与结构化用药嵌入、人体测量数据。
AI.result: 定制Transformer架构优于传统方法与零样本生成式LLM，在F1分数与Matthews相关系数（MCC）上取得最高表现；表明层级注意力机制能更好捕捉医疗长文本的长程依赖。
AI.conclusion: 面向长上下文的专用层级注意力Transformer能为临床风险分层提供稳健的自动化替代方案，减少对人工工作流的依赖。
AI.translation: 为克服老年心血管风险管理中手工行政编码的局限性，本研究提出一种利用非结构化电子健康记录（EHR）的自动化分类框架。我们使用3,482名患者的数据集，在荷兰语纵向临床叙事上对三种建模范式进行了基准比较：经典机器学习基线、针对大上下文序列优化的专用深度学习架构，以及在零样本设定下的通用生成式大语言模型（LLM）。此外，我们评估了一种后期融合策略，将非结构化文本与结构化用药嵌入和人体测量数据进行整合。分析表明，定制Transformer架构优于传统方法与生成式LLM，在F1分数与Matthews相关系数上取得最佳结果。这些发现强调了专用层级注意力机制在捕捉医学文本长程依赖方面的关键作用，为临床风险分层提供了对手工流程的稳健自动化替代。
AI.summary: 研究面向老年心血管风险管理的自动分类：在3,482名患者的荷兰语纵向EHR叙事文本上，对比传统ML、长上下文深度模型与零样本LLM，并尝试将文本与用药嵌入、人体测量数据进行后期融合。结果显示，具层级注意力的定制Transformer在F1与MCC上最佳，说明专用长文本建模比零样本通用LLM更适合该类临床编码/分层任务。
AI.keywords: 电子健康记录(EHR); 心血管风险管理; 自动分类; 临床叙事文本; 长上下文建模; 定制Transformer; 层级注意力; 零样本LLM; 后期融合; 用药嵌入; 人体测量数据; F1; Matthews相关系数(MCC)
AI.comments: 优点：在真实纵向临床叙事上系统比较三类范式，并报告F1与MCC，突出层级注意力对长程依赖的重要性；同时考虑结构化信息融合。局限：摘要未说明具体标签体系/任务定义、数据划分与外部验证、各模型细节与统计显著性、融合策略带来的增益幅度、以及零样本LLM的提示设计与版本。

title: Fusing Semantic, Lexical, and Domain Perspectives for Recipe Similarity Estimation
comments: Preprint version submitted to IEEE Big Data 2025
summary: This research focuses on developing advanced methods for assessing similarity between recipes by combining different sources of information and analytical approaches. We explore the semantic, lexical, and domain similarity of food recipes, evaluated through the analysis of ingredients, preparation methods, and nutritional attributes. A web-based interface was developed to allow domain experts to validate the combined similarity results. After evaluating 318 recipe pairs, experts agreed on 255 (80%). The evaluation of expert assessments enables the estimation of which similarity aspects--lexical, semantic, or nutritional--are most influential in expert decision-making. The application of these methods has broad implications in the food industry and supports the development of personalized diets, nutrition recommendations, and automated recipe generation systems.

AI.title_translation: 融合语义、词汇与领域视角的菜谱相似性估计
AI.tldr: 提出将语义、词汇与领域（营养等）多视角信息融合来估计菜谱相似性，并通过网页界面让专家验证；在318对菜谱中专家对255对（80%）达成一致，同时分析哪些相似性维度最影响专家判断。
AI.motivation: 单一视角难以准确衡量菜谱相似性；需要融合多源信息以支持个性化饮食、营养推荐与自动化菜谱生成等应用。
AI.method: 融合三类相似性：词汇相似性、语义相似性与领域/营养相似性；基于食材、制作方法与营养属性进行分析；开发网页端界面供领域专家对融合后的相似性结果进行验证，并利用专家评估来估计各相似性维度对决策的影响程度。
AI.result: 对318对菜谱进行评估，专家在255对上达成一致（80%）；专家评估可用于估计词汇、语义与营养等相似性因素在专家决策中的影响力大小。
AI.conclusion: 多视角融合方法可有效用于菜谱相似性估计，并具有食品行业应用价值，可支撑个性化饮食、营养推荐与自动化菜谱生成等系统的发展。
AI.translation: 本研究致力于通过结合不同信息来源与分析方法，开发更先进的菜谱相似性评估方法。我们从语义、词汇与领域三个层面考察食谱相似性，并通过对食材、制备方法和营养属性的分析进行评估。我们开发了一个基于网页的界面，使领域专家能够验证融合后的相似性结果。在评估的318对食谱中，专家对其中255对（80%）达成一致。对专家评估的分析使我们能够估计在专家决策中，词汇、语义或营养等相似性因素中哪些最具影响力。这些方法在食品行业具有广泛意义，并支持个性化饮食、营养推荐以及自动化菜谱生成系统的发展。
AI.summary: 论文提出一种菜谱相似性估计框架，融合词汇、语义与领域（尤其营养）信息，围绕食材、做法与营养属性计算相似性，并通过网页系统引入专家验证。对318对菜谱的专家评估显示80%一致性，同时可据此分析不同相似性维度对专家判断的相对重要性，面向个性化营养与自动菜谱生成等应用场景。
AI.keywords: 菜谱相似性; 多视角融合; 语义相似性; 词汇相似性; 营养相似性; 食材分析; 制作方法; 专家评估; 个性化饮食; 营养推荐; 自动化菜谱生成
AI.comments: 摘要未说明：具体相似性计算模型/算法（如嵌入、编辑距离、知识图谱等）、融合策略（加权/学习式融合）、专家人数与一致性度量方法、数据集来源与菜谱语种、与基线方法的对比结果及统计显著性。

title: AutoViVQA: A Large-Scale Automatically Constructed Dataset for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
summary:
Visual Question Answering (VQA) is a fundamental multimodal task that requires models to jointly understand visual and textual information. Early VQA systems relied heavily on language biases, motivating subsequent work to emphasize visual grounding and balanced datasets. With the success of large-scale pre-trained transformers for both text and vision domains -- such as PhoBERT for Vietnamese language understanding and Vision Transformers (ViT) for image representation learning -- multimodal fusion has achieved remarkable progress.
  For Vietnamese VQA, several datasets have been introduced to promote research in low-resource multimodal learning, including ViVQA, OpenViVQA, and the recently proposed ViTextVQA. These resources enable benchmarking of models that integrate linguistic and visual features in the Vietnamese context.
  Evaluation of VQA systems often employs automatic metrics originally designed for image captioning or machine translation, such as BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr, Recall, Precision, and F1-score. However, recent research suggests that large language models can further improve the alignment between automatic evaluation and human judgment in VQA tasks.
  In this work, we explore Vietnamese Visual Question Answering using transformer-based architectures, leveraging both textual and visual pre-training while systematically comparing automatic evaluation metrics under multilingual settings.

AI.title_translation: AutoViVQA：一个大规模自动构建的越南语视觉问答数据集
AI.tldr: 论文关注越南语VQA任务，利用文本与视觉预训练的Transformer架构进行建模，并在多语言设置下系统比较多种自动评价指标与人类判断的一致性。是否真正提出并发布“AutoViVQA”数据集及其规模细节在摘要中未明确说明。
AI.motivation: 早期VQA系统易受语言偏置影响，推动研究强调视觉落地与更均衡的数据集；同时越南语多模态属于低资源场景，需要数据集与基准促进研究；现有自动评价指标（BLEU、METEOR等）未必与人类判断一致，需在VQA中进一步验证与改进对齐。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的VQA架构，结合文本与视觉两端的预训练（示例提到越南语PhoBERT与视觉ViT），进行多模态融合；在多语言（multilingual）设置下，系统比较多种自动评价指标（BLEU、METEOR、CIDEr、Recall、Precision、F1等），并讨论利用大语言模型提升自动评价与人工评估的一致性。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation:
视觉问答（VQA）是一项基础的多模态任务，要求模型联合理解视觉与文本信息。早期VQA系统在很大程度上依赖语言偏置，这促使后续工作更强调视觉落地（visual grounding）与更均衡的数据集。随着文本与视觉领域的大规模预训练Transformer取得成功——例如用于越南语语言理解的PhoBERT，以及用于图像表征学习的视觉Transformer（ViT）——多模态融合取得了显著进展。

在越南语VQA方面，已有多个数据集被提出以推动低资源多模态学习研究，包括ViVQA、OpenViVQA，以及近期提出的ViTextVQA。这些资源支持在越南语语境下对融合语言与视觉特征的模型进行基准评测。

VQA系统的评估通常采用最初为图像描述或机器翻译设计的自动指标，如BLEU、METEOR、CIDEr、召回率（Recall）、精确率（Precision）与F1分数。然而，近期研究表明，大语言模型可以进一步提升VQA任务中自动评估与人工判断之间的一致性。

在本文中，我们使用基于Transformer的架构探索越南语视觉问答，利用文本与视觉的预训练，并在多语言设置下系统比较自动评价指标。
AI.summary: 该工作面向越南语视觉问答（VQA）这一低资源多模态任务，强调从早期语言偏置问题出发，通过引入文本/视觉预训练的Transformer模型来提升视觉—语言融合能力，并将研究重点之一放在评估层面：在多语言环境下对常用自动指标进行系统比较，同时指出可借助大语言模型改进自动评估与人工判断的对齐。摘要未给出具体实验结果、数据集构建细节或最终结论。
AI.keywords: 越南语VQA; 视觉问答; 多模态学习; 低资源; Transformer; PhoBERT; Vision Transformer; 自动评估指标; BLEU; METEOR; CIDEr; F1; 多语言; 大语言模型
AI.comments: 标题声称提出“AutoViVQA”大规模自动构建数据集，但摘要内容主要描述越南语VQA背景、相关数据集与评估指标比较框架，未明确说明AutoViVQA的数据来源、构建流程、规模、标注策略或与现有数据集的差异；实验设置与量化结果也未在摘要中提供。

title: ESAinsTOD: A Unified End-to-End Schema-Aware Instruction-Tuning Framework for Task-Oriented Dialog Modeling
comments: Published at International Journal of Machine Learning and Cybernetics (IJMLC)
summary: Existing end-to-end modeling methods for modular task-oriented dialog systems are typically tailored to specific datasets, making it challenging to adapt to new dialog scenarios. In this work, we propose ESAinsTOD, a unified End-to-end Schema-Aware Instruction-tuning framework for general Task-Oriented Dialog modeling. This framework introduces a structured methodology to go beyond simply fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling flexible adaptation to various dialogue task flows and schemas. Specifically, we leverage full-parameter fine-tuning of LLMs and introduce two alignment mechanisms to make the resulting system both instruction-aware and schema-aware: (i) instruction alignment, which ensures that the system faithfully follows task instructions to complete various task flows from heterogeneous TOD datasets; and (ii) schema alignment, which encourages the system to make predictions adhering to the specified schema. In addition, we employ session-level end-to-end modeling, which allows the system to access the results of previously executed task flows within the dialogue history, to bridge the gap between the instruction-tuning paradigm and the real-world application of TOD systems. Empirical results show that while a fine-tuned LLM serves as a strong baseline, our structured approach provides significant additional benefits. In particular, our findings indicate that: (i) ESAinsTOD outperforms state-of-the-art models by a significant margin on end-to-end task-oriented dialog modeling benchmarks: CamRest676, In-Car and MultiWOZ; (ii) more importantly, it exhibits superior generalization capabilities across various low-resource settings, with the proposed alignment mechanisms significantly enhancing zero-shot performance; and (iii) our instruction-tuning paradigm substantially improves the model's robustness against data noise and cascading errors.
comment: Published at International Journal of Machine Learning and Cybernetics (IJMLC)

AI.title_translation: ESAinsTOD：面向任务型对话建模的统一端到端模式感知指令微调框架
AI.tldr: 提出ESAinsTOD，通过全参数微调LLM并结合“指令对齐+模式对齐”和会话级端到端建模，实现对不同任务流程与schema的灵活适配，在多项TOD基准与低资源/零样本场景下显著优于SOTA且更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有模块化任务型对话（TOD）的端到端建模方法往往针对特定数据集定制，难以迁移到新的对话场景与不同的任务流程/模式（schema）。
AI.method: 提出统一的端到端Schema-Aware指令微调框架ESAinsTOD：1）对LLM进行全参数微调；2）两种对齐机制：a) 指令对齐，使模型严格遵循任务指令完成来自异构TOD数据集的多种任务流程；b) 模式对齐，使预测结果满足指定schema约束；3）会话级端到端建模，使模型可利用对话历史中先前已执行任务流程的结果，弥合指令微调范式与真实TOD应用之间差距。
AI.result: 实验表明：1）在CamRest676、In-Car、MultiWOZ等端到端TOD基准上显著超越SOTA；2）在多种低资源设置下泛化更强，且对齐机制显著提升零样本表现；3）指令微调范式显著提升对数据噪声与级联错误的鲁棒性；同时指出仅微调的LLM已是强基线，但结构化方法带来额外显著收益。
AI.conclusion: ESAinsTOD通过指令与schema双对齐及会话级端到端建模，使LLM在端到端任务型对话中更可迁移、更符合schema约束、在低资源/零样本下更强且更抗噪与抗级联错误。
AI.translation: 现有用于模块化任务型对话系统的端到端建模方法通常为特定数据集量身定制，因此难以适配新的对话场景。本文提出ESAinsTOD——一个面向通用任务型对话建模的统一端到端、模式感知的指令微调框架。该框架提供结构化方法，超越对大语言模型（LLM）的简单微调，从而能够灵活适配不同的对话任务流程与schema。具体而言，我们对LLM进行全参数微调，并引入两种对齐机制，使系统同时具备指令感知与模式感知能力：（i）指令对齐，确保系统忠实遵循任务指令，以完成来自异构TOD数据集的多种任务流程；（ii）模式对齐，促使系统的预测遵循给定schema。此外，我们采用会话级端到端建模，使系统能够访问对话历史中先前已执行任务流程的结果，以弥合指令微调范式与真实TOD应用之间的差距。实验结果显示，虽然微调后的LLM已是强基线，但我们的结构化方法还能带来显著额外收益。具体发现包括：（i）ESAinsTOD在CamRest676、In-Car与MultiWOZ等端到端任务型对话建模基准上显著超过最新方法；（ii）更重要的是，在多种低资源设置下展现更强泛化能力，且所提对齐机制显著增强零样本性能；（iii）该指令微调范式显著提升模型对数据噪声与级联错误的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 论文提出ESAinsTOD作为统一的端到端TOD建模框架，核心在于在全参数微调LLM基础上引入指令对齐与schema对齐，并通过会话级建模利用历史任务执行结果，从而同时提升对不同任务流程与schema的适配性、跨数据集/低资源与零样本泛化能力，以及对噪声与级联错误的鲁棒性；在CamRest676、In-Car、MultiWOZ上取得显著SOTA优势。
AI.keywords: 任务型对话; 端到端建模; 指令微调; 大语言模型; Schema感知; 指令对齐; 模式对齐; 低资源; 零样本; 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 优势：统一框架覆盖异构TOD流程与schema，并显式对齐指令与schema，结合会话级建模贴近真实应用；效果上同时提升SOTA、低资源/零样本与抗噪。局限：摘要未说明对齐机制的具体实现细节、训练数据构造与评测指标/消融设置，也未报告计算成本与推理开销。

title: ActiveUltraFeedback: Efficient Preference Data Generation using Active Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become the standard for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its efficacy is bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring preference data, especially in low-resource and expert domains. To address this, we introduce ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK, a modular active learning pipeline that leverages uncertainty estimates to dynamically identify the most informative responses for annotation. Our pipeline facilitates the systematic evaluation of standard response selection methods alongside DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING (DRTS) and DELTAUCB, two novel methods prioritizing response pairs with large predicted quality gaps, leveraging recent results showing that such pairs provide good signals for fine-tuning. Our experiments demonstrate that ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK yields high-quality datasets that lead to significant improvements in downstream performance, notably achieving comparable or superior results with as little as one-sixth of the annotated data relative to static baselines. Our pipeline is available at https://github.com/lasgroup/ActiveUltraFeedback and our preference datasets at https://huggingface.co/ActiveUltraFeedback.

AI.title_translation: ActiveUltraFeedback：使用主动学习高效生成偏好数据
AI.tldr: 提出一个基于不确定性估计的模块化主动学习标注管线，通过新策略DRTS与DeltaUCB优先选择预测质量差距大的回答对进行标注，在仅约六分之一标注数据量下即可达到或超过静态基线的下游性能。
AI.motivation: RLHF对齐LLM依赖偏好数据，但偏好数据获取成本高，尤其在低资源与专家领域，导致对齐效果受数据成本瓶颈限制。
AI.method: 提出ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK模块化主动学习管线：利用不确定性估计动态挑选最具信息量的回答进行人工偏好标注；支持系统性评估标准响应选择方法；并提出两种新选择策略——DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING（DRTS）与DELTAUCB——优先选择预测质量差距较大的回答对（基于近期发现：大质量差距对微调信号更好）。
AI.result: 实验表明该管线生成的偏好数据集质量高，带来显著下游性能提升；与静态基线相比，在仅使用约1/6标注数据的情况下即可获得相当或更优的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的主动学习与优先选择大预测质量差距的回答对，可显著降低偏好数据标注成本，同时保持或提升RLHF相关的下游性能；并公开了代码与数据集资源。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 论文针对RLHF偏好数据昂贵的问题，提出ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK主动学习标注管线，用不确定性估计挑选最信息量的样本，并引入DRTS与DeltaUCB以优先标注预测质量差距大的回答对，从而以更少标注数据构建高质量偏好数据集并提升下游表现，且提供开源实现与数据发布。
AI.keywords: RLHF, 大语言模型对齐, 偏好数据生成, 主动学习, 不确定性估计, 采样/选择策略, DRTS, DeltaUCB, 数据效率, 低资源领域
AI.comments: 贡献点包括：模块化主动学习偏好数据生成管线；提出DRTS与DeltaUCB两种新响应对选择方法；在数据效率上报告约6倍标注节省仍达成或超过静态基线。局限与细节（如不确定性估计实现、具体任务与指标、与哪些静态/标准方法对比）在摘要中未展开。

title: Physics-informed neural operator for predictive parametric phase-field modelling
summary: Predicting the microstructural and morphological evolution of materials through phase-field modelling is computationally intensive, particularly for high-throughput parametric studies. While neural operators such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) show promise in accelerating the solution of parametric partial differential equations (PDEs), the lack of explicit physical constraints, may limit generalisation and long-term accuracy for complex phase-field dynamics. Here, we develop a physics-informed neural operator framework to learn parametric phase-field PDEs, namely PF-PINO. By embedding the residuals of phase-field governing equations into the data-fidelity loss function, our framework effectively enforces physical constraints during training. We validate PF-PINO against benchmark phase-field problems, including electrochemical corrosion, dendritic crystal solidification, and spinodal decomposition. Our results demonstrate that PF-PINO significantly outperforms conventional FNO in accuracy, generalisation capability, and long-term stability. This work provides a robust and efficient computational tool for phase-field modelling and highlights the potential of physics-informed neural operators to advance scientific machine learning for complex interfacial evolution problems.

AI.title_translation: 用于预测性参数化相场建模的物理信息神经算子
AI.tldr: 提出PF-PINO（物理信息神经算子）在训练中引入相场控制方程残差作为物理约束，在多类基准相场问题上相比传统FNO表现出更高精度、更强泛化与更好的长期稳定性。
AI.motivation: 相场模型用于预测材料微观结构与形貌演化时计算代价高，尤其在高通量参数化研究中更为突出；现有神经算子（如FNO）虽可加速参数化PDE求解，但缺少显式物理约束，可能限制对复杂相场动力学的泛化能力与长期准确性。
AI.method: 提出物理信息神经算子框架PF-PINO，用于学习参数化相场PDE；将相场控制方程的残差项嵌入数据拟合（data-fidelity）损失函数中，以在训练阶段显式施加物理约束，并在多个基准相场任务上进行验证。
AI.result: 在电化学腐蚀、枝晶凝固与自旋分解等基准问题上，PF-PINO在精度、泛化能力与长期稳定性方面显著优于传统FNO。
AI.conclusion: PF-PINO为相场建模提供了鲁棒且高效的计算工具，并表明物理信息神经算子有潜力推动复杂界面演化问题的科学机器学习发展。
AI.translation: 材料微观结构与形貌演化的相场建模预测计算开销巨大，尤其在高通量参数研究中更为明显。尽管诸如傅里叶神经算子（FNO）等神经算子在加速参数化偏微分方程（PDE）求解方面展现出前景，但由于缺乏显式物理约束，可能会限制其在复杂相场动力学中的泛化能力与长期准确性。本文提出一种用于学习参数化相场PDE的物理信息神经算子框架PF-PINO。通过将相场控制方程的残差嵌入到数据保真损失函数中，该框架在训练过程中有效施加物理约束。我们在包括电化学腐蚀、枝晶晶体凝固以及自旋分解在内的基准相场问题上验证了PF-PINO。结果表明，PF-PINO在准确性、泛化能力和长期稳定性方面显著优于传统FNO。本工作为相场建模提供了鲁棒且高效的计算工具，并凸显了物理信息神经算子在推进复杂界面演化问题科学机器学习方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 论文针对相场模型参数化模拟计算昂贵与神经算子缺少物理约束导致的泛化/长期漂移问题，提出PF-PINO：在神经算子训练的损失函数中加入相场控制方程残差以强化物理一致性，并在腐蚀、枝晶凝固与自旋分解等任务上验证其相对FNO在精度、泛化与长期稳定性上的优势。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经算子; 神经算子; 傅里叶神经算子(FNO); 相场模型; 参数化PDE; 方程残差约束; 微观结构演化; 界面演化; 长期稳定性; 科学机器学习

title: DRIFT: Dual-Representation Inter-Fusion Transformer for Automated Driving Perception with 4D Radar Point Clouds
summary: 4D radars, which provide 3D point cloud data along with Doppler velocity, are attractive components of modern automated driving systems due to their low cost and robustness under adverse weather conditions. However, they provide a significantly lower point cloud density than LiDAR sensors. This makes it important to exploit not only local but also global contextual scene information. This paper proposes DRIFT, a model that effectively captures and fuses both local and global contexts through a dual-path architecture. The model incorporates a point path to aggregate fine-grained local features and a pillar path to encode coarse-grained global features. These two parallel paths are intertwined via novel feature-sharing layers at multiple stages, enabling full utilization of both representations. DRIFT is evaluated on the widely used View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset and a proprietary internal dataset. It outperforms the baselines on the tasks of object detection and/or free road estimation. For example, DRIFT achieves a mean average precision (mAP) of 52.6\% (compared to, say, 45.4\% of CenterPoint) on the VoD dataset.

title: TemporalDoRA: Temporal PEFT for Robust Surgical Video Question Answering
summary: Surgical Video Question Answering (VideoQA) requires accurate temporal grounding while remaining robust to natural variation in how clinicians phrase questions, where linguistic bias can arise. Standard Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) methods adapt pretrained projections without explicitly modeling frame-to-frame interactions within the adaptation pathway, limiting their ability to exploit sparse temporal evidence. We introduce TemporalDoRA, a video-specific PEFT formulation that extends Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation by (i) inserting lightweight temporal Multi-Head Attention (MHA) inside the low-rank bottleneck of the vision encoder and (ii) selectively applying weight decomposition only to the trainable low-rank branch rather than the full adapted weight. This design enables temporally-aware updates while preserving a frozen backbone and stable scaling. By mixing information across frames within the adaptation subspace, TemporalDoRA steers updates toward temporally consistent visual cues and improves robustness with minimal parameter overhead. To benchmark this setting, we present REAL-Colon-VQA, a colonoscopy VideoQA dataset with 6,424 clip--question pairs, including paired rephrased Out-of-Template questions to evaluate sensitivity to linguistic variation. TemporalDoRA improves Out-of-Template performance, and ablation studies confirm that temporal mixing inside the low-rank branch is the primary driver of these gains. We also validate on EndoVis18-VQA adapted to short clips and observe consistent improvements on the Out-of-Template split. Code and dataset available at~\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TemporalDoRA-BFC8/}{Anonymous GitHub}.

AI.title_translation: TemporalDoRA：用于鲁棒外科视频问答的时序PEFT方法

AI.method: TemporalDoRA：一种面向视频的PEFT，扩展Weight-Decomposed LoRA/DoRA。关键设计：(i) 在视觉编码器的低秩瓶颈内插入轻量时序Multi-Head Attention以在适配子空间进行跨帧信息混合；(ii) 仅对可训练的低秩分支选择性进行权重分解，而非对完整适配权重分解，从而保持冻结骨干与稳定缩放；并构建REAL-Colon-VQA（6424段视频-问题对，含配对改写的Out-of-Template问句）用于评测语言变体敏感性。

title: Mousse: Rectifying the Geometry of Muon with Curvature-Aware Preconditioning
summary: Recent advances in spectral optimization, notably Muon, have demonstrated that constraining update steps to the Stiefel manifold can significantly accelerate training and improve generalization. However, Muon implicitly assumes an isotropic optimization landscape, enforcing a uniform spectral update norm across all eigen-directions. We argue that this "egalitarian" constraint is suboptimal for Deep Neural Networks, where the curvature spectrum is known to be highly heavy-tailed and ill-conditioned. In such landscapes, Muon risks amplifying instabilities in high-curvature directions while limiting necessary progress in flat directions. In this work, we propose \textbf{Mousse} (\textbf{M}uon \textbf{O}ptimization \textbf{U}tilizing \textbf{S}hampoo's \textbf{S}tructural \textbf{E}stimation), a novel optimizer that reconciles the structural stability of spectral methods with the geometric adaptivity of second-order preconditioning. Instead of applying Newton-Schulz orthogonalization directly to the momentum matrix, Mousse operates in a whitened coordinate system induced by Kronecker-factored statistics (derived from Shampoo). Mathematically, we formulate Mousse as the solution to a spectral steepest descent problem constrained by an anisotropic trust region, where the optimal update is derived via the polar decomposition of the whitened gradient. Empirical results across language models ranging from 160M to 800M parameters demonstrate that Mousse consistently outperforms Muon, achieving around $\sim$12\% reduction in training steps with negligible computational overhead.

AI.title_translation: Mousse：通过曲率感知预条件化校正 Muon 的几何性质
AI.tldr: 提出 Mousse，将 Shampoo 的 Kronecker 分解统计用于白化坐标系中的谱优化更新，通过在白化梯度上做极分解来获得各向异性信赖域下的最优谱步长；在 160M–800M 语言模型上相较 Muon 训练步数减少约 12%，且额外开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: Muon 将更新限制在 Stiefel 流形并强制各特征方向统一的谱更新范数，隐含假设优化景观各向同性；但深度网络曲率谱通常重尾且病态，导致 Muon 可能放大高曲率方向不稳定并抑制平坦方向的必要进展，因此需要结合曲率自适应的谱方法。
AI.method: Mousse（Muon Optimization Utilizing Shampoo's Structural Estimation）：利用来自 Shampoo 的 Kronecker-factored 统计构造白化坐标系；不直接对动量矩阵做 Newton-Schulz 正交化，而是在白化空间中进行；将其形式化为在各向异性信赖域约束下的谱最速下降问题，并通过对白化梯度进行极分解（polar decomposition）推导最优更新。
AI.result: 在 160M 到 800M 参数规模的语言模型实验中，Mousse 相比 Muon 一贯更优，训练步数减少约 12%，且计算开销几乎不增加。
AI.conclusion: 通过将谱方法的结构稳定性与二阶预条件化的几何自适应性结合，Mousse 能更好地应对重尾、病态的曲率谱，从而比 Muon 更高效地训练大型语言模型并保持低额外成本。
AI.translation: 近期谱优化（尤其是 Muon）的进展表明，将更新步限制在 Stiefel 流形上能显著加速训练并改善泛化。然而，Muon 隐式假设优化景观各向同性，在所有特征方向上施加统一的谱更新范数。我们认为这种“平均主义”约束对深度神经网络并不理想，因为其曲率谱已知高度重尾且病态。在这种景观中，Muon 可能放大高曲率方向的不稳定性，同时限制在平坦方向上的必要进展。本文提出 Mousse（Muon Optimization Utilizing Shampoo's Structural Estimation），一种新型优化器，用曲率感知的二阶预条件化来调和谱方法的结构稳定性与几何自适应性。Mousse 不再直接对动量矩阵进行 Newton-Schulz 正交化，而是在由 Shampoo 的 Kronecker 分解统计诱导的白化坐标系中工作。数学上，我们将 Mousse 表述为在各向异性信赖域约束下的谱最速下降问题，最优更新可通过对白化梯度进行极分解得到。对 160M 到 800M 参数的语言模型实验表明，Mousse 稳定优于 Muon，在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下，将训练步数减少约 12%。
AI.summary: 该工作指出 Muon 的 Stiefel 约束等价于对所有特征方向施加同等步长尺度，难以适配深网中重尾且病态的曲率谱；为此提出 Mousse，引入 Shampoo 的 Kronecker 统计进行白化，在白化空间内通过极分解求解带各向异性信赖域的谱最速下降更新，从而在多种 160M–800M 语言模型上以几乎零额外开销实现约 12% 的训练步数降低。
AI.keywords: 谱优化; Stiefel 流形; Muon; Mousse; Shampoo; Kronecker 分解; 预条件化; 二阶方法; 白化; 极分解; 各向异性信赖域; 语言模型训练
AI.comments: 优点：明确针对 Muon 的各向同性假设与深网曲率重尾不匹配的问题，方法上将谱约束与二阶结构信息结合，并报告在较大规模语言模型上稳定收益且开销低。局限：摘要未说明具体实现细节（如统计更新频率、矩阵幂近似、内存占用）、对不同任务/架构的泛化范围，以及与其他强基线（如 AdamW、Shampoo、K-FAC 等）的全面对比与消融分析。

title: An Empirical Study of Interaction Smells in Multi-Turn Human-LLM Collaborative Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized code generation, evolving from static tools into dynamic conversational interfaces that facilitate complex, multi-turn collaborative programming. While LLMs exhibit remarkable proficiency in generating standalone code snippets, they often struggle to maintain contextual consistency during extended interactions, creating significant obstacles in the collaboration process. Existing benchmarks primarily emphasize the functional correctness of the final output, overlooking latent quality issues within the interaction process itself, which we term Interaction Smells. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on sampled real-word user-LLM interactions from WildChat and LMSYS-Chat-1M datasets to systematically investigate Interaction Smells in human-LLM code generation tasks from the perspectives of phenomena, distribution, and mitigation. First, we establish the first taxonomy of Interaction Smells by manually performing open card sorting on real-world interaction logs. This taxonomy categorizes Interaction Smells into three primary categories, i.e., User Intent Quality, Historical Instruction Compliance, and Historical Response Violation, comprising nine specific subcategories. Next, we quantitatively evaluate six mainstream LLMs (i.e., GPT-4o, DeepSeek-Chat, Gemini 2.5, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Qwen3-235B-a22b) to analyze the distribution of Interaction Smells across different models. Finally, we propose Invariant-aware Constraint Evolution (InCE), a multi-agent framework designed to improve multi-turn interaction quality through explicit extraction of global invariants and pre-generation quality audits. Experimental results on the extended WildBench benchmark demonstrate that this lightweight mitigation approach significantly improves the Task Success Rate and effectively suppresses the occurrence of Interaction Smells.

AI.title_translation: 多轮人类—大语言模型协同代码生成中的交互异味实证研究
